method: After freezing and replaying the pair, returned to Appendices III and IV, reconstructed the 60+60+60 EC allocation from the actual required and selected components, and checked the catalog’s 145 EC project gate and both minor periods. Reconsidered the UCR laboratory, design, robotics, physiology and image-analysis contributions against the underlying evidence and confirmed where specialist engineering coverage remains separate. Worker A conducted both passes.
findings: The English-taught BSc Biomedical Engineering includes 60 EC each in years one and two, 30 EC in a year-three minor and 30 EC in the final semester. The formal first-year table splits Microbiology WBBE026-04 (4 EC) and Safe Microbiological Techniques WBBE061-01 (1 EC). The catalog confirms the courses are taught together and credits them separately; its registration note’s legacy microbiology code does not change the formal credit allocation. The second-year named core totals 60 EC. The generic target illustrates Biomaterials Science and Engineering, the first specialization in Appendix II. The deepening minor uses Lab Course Biomaterials with Biofabrication and Biomedical Instrumentation in 1A and Polymeric Materials with Surface Characterization and Transport in Biological Systems in 1B, taking one specialization course and two permitted electives per period. The final 30 EC consists of Computational Methods (5), Research Ethics (2), Research Course BME (3), Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Medicine (5) and Bachelor’s Project BME (15). The tissue course is one of two final-semester choices. The illustrated minor is one permitted structure; approved alternatives are available.

The catalog places quantitative foundations, design, life science and safe laboratory work in year one, and physics, electronics, biomedical design, signals and image processing in year two. The six minor courses fall in the two allowed periods. The project begins after at least 145 EC in the Biomedical Engineering curriculum, including all first-year courses, Safe Microbiological Techniques and Research Course BME. Approved minor courses count toward the threshold and the project is scheduled in 2B after the research course in 2A. The sample has 150 EC before the last semester and 165 EC before the project if the planned courses are passed. The adopted rules replace the old longer research course with separate Research Course BME and Computational Methods. The catalog describes a supervised research or design project and requires an English report and presentation.

The broad plan integrates physiology and anatomy, cell and molecular biology, laboratory microbiology, immunology and disease with signal analysis, mathematics, computer vision, robotics and product design. The device-oriented plan combines anatomy, physiology and biomedical lab work with general robotics, epidemiology and prevention evidence, design, user and market research, organizational psychology and cross-border business law. The late general product-design course is now available after technical and health foundations. It provides prototyping and sustainability assessment rather than clinical device engineering or certification. The data and image-analysis plan uses anatomy and neuroscience as applications for mathematical modelling, signals, numerical methods, databases, feature tracking and machine learning. General image processing has real overlap with biomedical image analysis but does not teach scanner physics or instrumentation. The plans are distinct at the course and concept levels. The biomaterials direction was tested against sustainability chemistry, materials characterization and recycling evidence, cell and molecular biology and the Life Science Laboratory. These offer transferable tools and environmental or molecular contexts. They do not form a sequence in implant and biomaterial design, material interactions with tissue, specialist fabrication and regenerative engineering. The twelve aligned rows are bounded to shared content, and the required engineering labs, physics, electronics and project remain clearly visible.
